decision_conditions:
<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details for the
disposal of surface water, surface water attenuation and storage works and shall thereafter be retained.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details for the
disposal of sewage and shall thereafter be retained.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby approved
shall&nbsp;not be first occupied until a
scheme for the hard and soft landscaping details have been submitted to, and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, to include the following <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">A scheme for the detailed hard
landscaping of the development shall include<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Details of the planting, tree planting and tree pits, climbing
rocks, shallow swale. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), written
specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken and schedules
of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of
planting) and proposed numbers / densities and an implementation programme. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">A scheme for the detailed hard
landscaping of the development shall include<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The hard surfacing details shall include samples to show the
texture and colour of the materials to be used and information about their
sourcing/manufacturer. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Details of all boundary treatments and access gates including
a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary
treatment/access gates to be erected <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be carried out in
accordance with the scheme so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.
The hard landscaping details shall be completed in accordance with the approved
details prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">All planting, seeding or turfing
comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the
first planting and seeding seasons following the first occupation of the
building, or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs which,
within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are
removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next
planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local
authority agrees any variation in writing.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby approved
shall not be occupied until a scheme for the on-going landscape management,
management programme of works and landscape maintenance of all the hard and
soft landscaping within the development, to include a Landscape Management
Plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and
Landscape Maintenance schedules including a calendar of routine physical tasks
for all landscape areas and plant replacement strategy for plant failures shall
be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior
to the first occupation of the development or any phase of the development,
whichever is the sooner, for its permitted use.&nbsp;
The Landscape Management Plan and Landscape Maintenance Plan shall be
carried out in a timely manner as approved.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The window(s) in the first floor
northern elevation of plots 1 and 2 and western elevation of plot 4 of the
proposed development shall:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">(a) be of purpose-made obscure
glass,<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">(b) be permanently fixed closed
below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">and shall thereafter be retained
in that form.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Evidence of certification of
Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the
Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any part of the
development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and
operated in accordance with any approval.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby permitted
shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and
documents:&nbsp;</span>Extended Phase 1 Habitat Survey
Report; Arboricultural Survey Report and
Impact Assessment; Transport Note; Flood Risk
Assessment; Design and Access Statement; 20040 P-01; 20040 P-02; 3586 BR 400 Rev K; 3586 BR 300 Rev J; 3586 BR 200 Rev J; 20040 SLP-01; GW-HA072-P-1001 Rev B; GW-HA072-P-1002.</p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby approved
shall not be occupied until details of:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; location
of the cycle stores for 2 cycles within the rear gardens, elevation and
external finish details <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle storage shall be
made available prior to the first occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the provisions of
the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or
any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no
development in relation to the proposed dwellings which would otherwise fall
within Classes A, AA, B and E of Part 1 of Schedule 2 of that Order and Class L
of Schedule 2, Part 3 Shall be carried out without the prior written permission
of the Local Planning Authority.</span></p>
<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Levels plan.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Fire Safety Statement. The development shall be operated
in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details for lighting and the lighting shall be retained as such thereafter.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;">The development shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved Detailed Construction Logistics Plan, or
any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local
Planning Authority.</p>
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission P/0632/22 dated 28/06/2022 to allow revised drawing showing parapet walls to elevations
